mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_callback_event (provider, provider_event_id, event_type, signature_verified, payload_hash, payload, transaction_id, process_status, reject_reason, received_at, created_by) VALUES (#{row.provider}, #{row.providerEventId}, #{row.eventType}, #{row.signatureVerified}, #{row.payloadHash}, #{row.payload,typeHandler=com.xsy.scm.common.json.JsonbObjectMapTypeHandler}, #{row.transactionId}, #{row.processStatus}, #{row.rejectReason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{row.createdBy}) ON CONFLICT (provider, provider_event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment_callback_event WHERE provider = #{provider} AND provider_event_id = #{providerEventId}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_callback_event SET process_status = #{processStatus}, transaction_id = #{transactionId}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
